title: Convenience at it's finest
description:
Mod-pack made just for all the best QoL mods I could find.
This aims to fix tedious features in-game without adding anything new.
body:
All the convenience mods, and the finest ones of course!

If you hate the inconveniences of features in Minecraft (like me) then you should download this mod-pack!  
It removes many and will remove more tedious things so all that's left is the fun of Minecraft. Litterally, it doesn't add anything other than QoL!

I went through Modrinth looking for QoL mods, when I found one, I searched for a better version of it.  
When I was done with that, I played the game, and evertime I came across something tedious or annoying, I added the best mod I could find to fix that. It didn't take too long until there was an abundance of them.

You of course can't use this mod-pack when joining servers, and if you want to combine this with an actual mod-pack, just move the contents of the mods/texture-pack folder.

### Mods:
- Serilum:
  - Inventory totem
    - Don't need to hold totems for them to work
  - Inventory mending
    - Anytime you gain XP, it will mend all items in inventory
  - Bottle your XP
    - Crouch + RC with bottle to create Bottle o' Enchanting (Idk if this is compatible with Fixed Levels mod)
  - Fixed anvil repair cost
    - Customizeable costs for repairing tools
  - Anvil restoration
    - Repair anvils with iron
  - Better beacon/conduit placement
    - RC beacon/conduit with block to autoplace, and crouch + RC to place all in hand
  - Tree/ore harvester
    - Crouch + mine to break all logs/ores
  - Recast
    - Automatically recast fishing rod when caught something
  - Replanting crops
    - Replants crops with drops when hit, crouch to disable
  - Keep my soil tilled
    - Melons/pumpkins don't break soil
  - Extended bone meal
    - Bone meal works on more things
  - Silkier touch
    - Silk touch works on more things
  - Mineral chance
    - Occasionally find ores in stone (can turn this off by putting values to 0)
  - Dismount entity
    - Crouch + RC vehicle to remove entity
  - Wandering trader may leave
    - Click top-left button to make trader dissapear
  - Infinite trades
    - Trades are unlimeted, also customize which types of villagers are infinite
  - Compact help command
    - Better help command
  - Hand over your items
    - Crouch + RC a player with every item you want to give to them, then Crouch + RC with no item to confirm
  - Quick right-click
    - RC air to use most blocks with GUIs
  - Cycle paintings
    - RC placed painting with painting to cycle them
  - Full bright toggle
    - Press keybind ("P"?) to light everything up
  - Improved sign editing
    - Auto selects new or old lines when editing text
  - TNT breaks berock
    - TNT can explode bedrock near it
- Mod menu
  - See your mods in title/pause menu
- Apple skin
  - Show saturation on HUD and show values on items
- Jade
  - Tells you what you're looking at
- Essential mod
  - Multiplayer
- XP Clumps
  - Reduces lag when mass amounts of XP are present
- Better than mending
  - Crouch + RC tool with mending to mend
- Fixed levels
  - Customized XP level requirement
- Anvils too expensive fix
  - There is no limit to how costly an anvil use can be
- Universal enchants
  - Removes most enchantment incompatibility and makes some enchantments work on more tools
- Auto tools
  - Press keybind (left alt) to toggle (?) automatically using the correct tool
- Inventory profiles next
  - Sorting, autofilling emptied stacks in hotbar, and quickly moving mass items
- Shulkerbox tooltip
  - See what's in a container without placing it
- Bundles beyond
  - Easy to use bundles
- Infinite inventory
  - Shift + click an item in inventory to transfer to infinite inventory (close menu to gain back the functionality of shift + click)
- Blasting raw metal blocks
  - Smetl raw ore blocks in blast furnaces
- Enchanted golden apple addition
  - Craft enchanted golden apples
- Bridging mod
  - Press keybind (",") to toggle reaching around blocks
- Simple death improvements
  - No splatter, permanence, lava/void gaurd, explosion resistance, keep more experience, customizeable keep inventory
- Crawl
  - Press keybind (tab?) to force crawl
- Controlify
  - Map your buttons to your keybinds
- Click villagers
  - Crouch + RC to pick up villagers, reroll trades, and anchoring villagers
- PB warps
  - Use "/warp" to see your warps, and "/warp**s**" to create, remove, or modify
- NBT autocomplete
  - Autocomplete in commands works better
- Continuity
  - Connected textures
- Lamb's dynamic lights
  - Items that would intuitively glow, now glow when held or dropped (also works on mobs)
- Presence footsteps
  - Immersive footsteps
- Inventory particles
  - Particles emit off of items in GUIs
- ~~Carry on~~
  - Shift + RC certain mobs/blocks to pick them up (stacking mobs)
- ~~No creative drift~~
  - No more drift when flying (doesn't fully work)
- ~~Inventory interactions~~
  - Animations and movement on items in GUIs
- ~~Experience progress~~
  - See your progress on your XP (Idk if this is compatible with Fixed Levels mod)
- ~~Hudless~~
  - Removes HUD from screen when not used
- ~~Omnidirectional movement~~
  - Sprint in all directions
- ~~Music control~~
  - Control what Minecraft track plays
- ~~Packed inventory~~
  - See AND manage what's in a container without placing it

### Texture packs:
- Enchanted books: recovered
  - Enchanted books are discernable
- Recolorful containers
  - Puts style in your GUI
- 3D crops revamped
  - 3D crops, nether wart and sugarcane too
- Primes textures
  - Almost everything is HD
- Fresh animations
  - Regular
  - Extension
  - Player
    - Immersive mobs

Depending on which mod-pack version/game version you are getting, some of these may or may not be on it. (Some are not listed here because they are not from the newest version of this pack.)

More to come! (I might make a Discord server for suggestions.)
